title: 折桂令·春情
author: 徐再思
intro: A young woman falls in love for the first time and is instantly lovesick — body light as a cloud, heart like drifting willow down, breath thin as gossamer. Playful repetition makes it sound like a song.
analysis: 这首小令用一位少女的口吻写初恋的相思。开头三句很有趣：我这一辈子从来不懂什么是相思，刚刚懂得相思，就害上了相思病。三个“相思”连用，读起来像绕口令，也写出感情来得又快又猛。接着三个比喻：身体像浮云一样轻飘无力，心像飘飞的柳絮一样乱，气息像游丝一样细弱——把相思病写得像真的病一样。她为什么这样？因为那个“千金游子”（她爱的人，一位尊贵的公子）走了，只留下一缕余香，不知他去了哪里。最后自问自答：这病什么时候最厉害？就在灯光半暗、月亮半明的时候——也就是深夜一个人醒着的时候。曲中“思”“丝”“此”“之”“时”押同一个韵，结尾四个“时”字连用，音乐感很强。
analysisEn: This short song is spoken by a young woman in love for the first time. The opening is playful: “All my life I never knew lovesickness; now that I know it at last, I’m sick with it.” The word 相思 (“longing”) comes three times in a row, almost like a tongue-twister, showing how fast and hard the feeling hits her. Then three comparisons: her body is light and weak as a drifting cloud, her heart scattered like flying willow down, her breath thin as a floating thread of gossamer — lovesickness described as if it were a real illness. Why? The man she loves, a well-born young traveller, has left; only a wisp of his fragrance lingers, and she doesn’t know where he has gone. She ends with a question and answer: when are the symptoms worst? When the lamp is half dim and the moon half bright — late at night, alone and awake. Almost every line ends on the same rhyme (思, 丝, 此, 之, 时), and the last lines repeat 时 (“time”) four times, giving it a strong musical feel.
background: Xu Zaisi (dates unknown, active in the early 14th century) was a Yuan sanqu writer nicknamed “Sweet Studio” (甜斋). He was paired with Guan Yunshi, “Sour Studio”, and their collected songs were known as the “Sour and Sweet Songs”.
pronunciation: 害相思：害 hài（患病）。一缕：缕 lǚ。何之：之 zhī（往、到）。证候：证 zhèng，候 hòu。
version: 采用通行版本。“证候来时”的“证候”又写作“症候”。

lines.py: píng shēng bù huì xiāng sī
lines.lit: All my life I didn’t know longing;
lines.en: All my life I never knew what longing was;

lines.py: cái huì xiāng sī, biàn hài xiāng sī
lines.lit: just as I came to know longing, I fell sick with longing.
lines.en: the moment I learned it, it made me ill.

lines.zh: 身似浮云，心如飞絮，气若游丝。
lines.rhythm: 身似/浮云，心如/飞絮，气若/游丝
lines.py: shēn sì fú yún, xīn rú fēi xù, qì ruò yóu sī
lines.lit: Body like a floating cloud, heart like flying catkins, breath like drifting gossamer.
lines.en: My body drifts like a cloud, my heart flies loose like willow down, my breath is thin as a spider’s thread.

lines.py: kōng yī lǚ yú xiāng zài cǐ
lines.lit: Only a wisp of lingering fragrance remains here, in vain;
lines.en: Only a wisp of his scent is left here —

lines.py: pàn qiān jīn yóu zǐ hé zhī
lines.lit: I long for the precious wanderer — where has he gone?
lines.en: I wait for my fine young traveller: where has he gone?

lines.py: zhèng hòu lái shí, zhèng shì hé shí
lines.lit: When the symptoms come, what time is it exactly?
lines.en: And when does the sickness come on worst?

lines.py: dēng bàn hūn shí, yuè bàn míng shí
lines.lit: When the lamp is half dim, when the moon is half bright.
lines.en: When the lamp is half dim and the moon is half bright.

words.note: 现代汉语仍用，如“平生第一次”。
现代汉语“相思病”仍常说。
现代汉语书面语，相当于“就”。
现代口语“害病”“害相思”仍说。
现代汉语“过眼浮云”比喻很快消失的东西。
絮：柳絮，现代汉语“柳絮”“棉絮”。

words.en: floating gossamer (spider threads in the air)
words.note: “气若游丝”今天仍是成语，形容呼吸非常微弱。
缕：量词，现代汉语“一缕阳光”。
余：剩下的，现代汉语“剩余”“余下”。

words.en: a well-born young man travelling far from home
words.note: 今天“千金”多指别人的女儿，这里指身份尊贵。
之：往、到。古语倒装，即“之何”——到哪里去。
现代汉语写作“症候”，中医仍说“证候”。

imagery.name: 云
imagery.zh: “身似浮云”，写相思使人身体轻飘、虚弱无力。
imagery.en: “Body like a floating cloud”: longing leaves her light-headed and weak.

imagery.name: 柳
imagery.zh: “心如飞絮”，柳絮随风乱飘，像她心神不定。
imagery.en: “Heart like flying willow down”: catkins tossed by the wind, like her restless heart.

imagery.name: 灯
imagery.zh: 半昏的灯光写深夜独坐，相思最苦的时刻。
imagery.en: A half-dim lamp means she sits up alone late at night — the worst time for longing.

imagery.name: 月
imagery.zh: 半明的月亮引起思念，与半昏的灯一起，写出朦胧、孤单的夜晚。
imagery.en: The half-bright moon stirs her longing; with the dim lamp it paints a hazy, lonely night.
